verdict.rationale: EFTPS's own pages describe the payment task in plain, non-statutory language: enroll, wait for a mailed PIN, schedule by 8 p.m. ET the day before the due date, and follow the voice prompts. These are scattered feature statements rather than a structured step-by-step explainer. Missing for 10: a documented step-by-step walkthrough of enrollment and payment, task-oriented explainers for founders (e.g., which tax type or form to pay), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the guidance is followable by non-experts.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes plain-language, step-by-step guidance for my task — explainers a non-lawyer can follow, not just statute text and form numbers

citations.quote: Enroll at EFTPS or request an enrollment from EFTPS Customer Service
you will receive a personal identification number (PIN) via U.S. Mail in five to seven business days
Payments using this Web site or our voice response system must be scheduled by 8 p.m. ET the day before the due date to be received timely by the IRS.
Follow the prompts to make your payment.
The funds will move out of your banking account on the date you select for settlement.
